messages:
Incident Bot: 🚨 alert: inference-service.us-west-2 p99 latency 1.9s (SLO burn 68% over 5m). pager: PD-9876. link: <https://obs.redwood.internal/d/abc123/latency-dashboard>
PagerDuty: PD-9876 fired for eng-oncall — High latency SLO burn. Please ack.
Jamie (oncall): Acked. I'm on it — pulling dashboards now.
Alex: saw a small deploy 3m ago to canary, but traffic routed to stable. Checking kvcache metrics.
Priya: Any customer-facing errors? I see no 5xx spike on front-tier dashboards.
Jamie (oncall): p95 ~ 420ms, p99 ~ 1.9s on /v1/generate-hotpath. Throughput +22% compared to baseline. KV cache evictions spiked.
Alex: grabbing hotpath pod logs, running quick checks.
Alex: ```
$ kubectl -n inference exec -it inference-svc-7d9b -- curl -s localhost:9000/metrics | grep kvcache
kvcache_evictions_total 1245
kvcache_hit_ratio 0.36
gpu_mem_usage_bytes 1125899906842624
``` 
Maria: gpu mem seems fine but look at continuous batching latency — maybe batching grew because KV miss rate increased.
OpsBot: autoscaler event: scaled up inference-pool from 12 -> 16 instances at 3250001180.
Jamie (oncall): autoscale happened, but new pods still warming KV caches. Can we force a graceful warm or fallback routing?
Priya: What routes use large context that exacerbate KV miss? /v1/chat-stream and /v1/generate-hotpath.
Alex: quick mitigation: enable prefix-caching bypass for hotpath to avoid large KV churn. Command I'm going to run:
Alex: ```
# temporarily set routing policy to prefer smaller-context variant
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $API" \
  https://platform.redwood.internal/configs/routing -d '{"route":"/v1/generate-hotpath","policy":"prefer-compact-model"}'
``` 
Jamie (oncall): Priya, can you prod traffic engineering to ensure canary traffic not hitting hotpath? @Maria I can hand you the handoff if this persists.
Maria: on it. I'm patching routing policy now.
Maria: ```
PATCH /configs/routing 200 OK
applied policy prefer-compact-model to /v1/generate-hotpath
``` 
Incident Bot: config-change recorded by Maria at 3250001295.
PagerDuty: PD-9876 acknowledged by Jamie (oncall) at 3250001190.
Jamie (oncall): After policy flip, p99 dropped to ~720ms in the next 60s window. Monitoring for 10m.
Priya: Noted. No customer 5xxs, but latency spikes affect interactive customers (support ticket opened). Tagging #support.
Alex: Follow-up check: KV cache pre-warm job can be triggered for new pods. Running prewarm script now (may add CPU load briefly).
Alex: ```
$ ./scripts/prewarm_kvcache.sh --pool inference-pool
prewarm started for 4 pods
status: warmup in progress
``` 
OpsBot: scheduled prewarm job started at 3250001340.
Maria: keeping an eye on autoscaler logs and queue length. If queue length > 500 for >2m, escalate to infra.
Jamie (oncall): If latency back under SLO for 15m, we'll close. If it wiggles, escalate.
Priya: Can we capture a short customer-impact blurb for postmortem? "Interactive latency increased on /v1/generate-hotpath causing higher response times for a subset of real-time users; no 5xxs observed; mitigated by routing to compact model and pre-warming caches." I'll save that.
Alex: prewarm completed, kvcache hit_ratio improved to 0.82 within 3 mins.
Jamie (oncall): Monitoring shows p99 now ~280ms and stable. Good.
Incident Bot: alert PD-9876 status: resolved (mitigated) at 3250001530 — alert closed automatically.
PagerDuty: PD-9876 resolved by Jamie (oncall).
Jamie (oncall): TL;DR: cause = KV cache eviction storm during sudden throughput bump; contributing = canary deploy + increased batch sizes; mitigation = routing to compact model + prewarm job + autoscale. Will draft a short postmortem and follow-up actions.
Maria: Action items: 1) add auto-prewarm on scale-up, 2) add circuit-breaker to prevent large batching growth, 3) improve canary isolation by route. I'll create tickets.
Priya: Notifying product & support for customer comms. Good job team :thumbsup:
Jamie (oncall): Handoff: Maria taking follow-ups, I'll update incident board and drop a PR for a runbook tweak. If anything regresses ping me directly.
OpsBot: Handoff noted — assigned incident PD-9876 to Maria for follow-ups.
Maria: acknowledged, will own until postmortem done.
